meta.title: Website Development Studio in Ukraine — Click IT
meta.description: Click IT is a full-cycle web studio: websites, online stores and landing pages, UI/UX design, SEO and Google Ads. Websites that grow your revenue.

hero.lead: Click IT is a full-cycle web studio. We research your niche, design the UX, then build and promote websites that bring customers and pay back the investment.

services.title: Our services
services.lead: We cover the full digital cycle — from idea and design to development and promotion.

development.title: Development
development.text: From landing pages and business card sites to online stores and complex web platforms. Turnkey — you run your business, we handle the website.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.text: We drive targeted traffic through SEO, paid search and social media — and turn visitors into loyal customers.

design.title: Design
design.text: Design as a reflection of your brand: corporate identity, UI/UX and interfaces that anyone understands.

approach.title: We don’t just build websites
approach.lead: For us a website is not only code — it’s business. Every stage serves one goal: the site has to work for you.

items.title: Understand
items.text: We dig into the specifics of your business and requirements before any work starts.

items.title: Strategy
items.text: We analyse the niche and competitors and define the site’s goal and the visitor’s target action.

items.title: UX/UI
items.text: We design intuitive navigation and a look your audience falls for at first sight.

items.title: Development
items.text: We build a fast, responsive and stable site — from a simple landing page to a web platform.

items.title: Launch
items.text: We test, set up analytics and launch the project on schedule.

items.title: Growth
items.text: We grow the project with SEO, PPC and SMM and keep it running with technical support.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.lead: Websites we have built and promoted for businesses across different industries.

items.title: A website that sells
items.text: Websites that truly sell start with niche research. We dig into its specifics so the site earns your audience’s trust.

items.title: Targeted traffic
items.text: We promote the site to your audience with SEO, SMM and PPC and build the marketing and communication strategy.

items.title: Conversion
items.text: We design around the visitor’s target action — a purchase, an order or a request — and remove everything in its way.

items.title: Digital system
items.text: Your website is an online representative working 24/7. We combine development, content, marketing and support into one system.

process.title: How we work
process.lead: A transparent process: at every stage you see the result and can request changes.

items.title: Analysis
items.text: We shape the idea: site goal, target audience, content, navigation and technical requirements.

items.title: Strategy
items.text: We write the specification: structure, modules, technologies and a description of the look.

items.title: UX/UI
items.text: Concept, several design options, home page and inner page layouts — approved step by step.

items.title: Development
items.text: Front-end and back-end development, easy content management, all screens and browsers.

items.title: Testing
items.text: A dedicated specialist checks loading speed, rendering, links and every module.

items.title: Launch
items.text: We deploy to hosting, connect the domain, and set up analytics and webmaster tools.

items.title: Growth
items.text: 24/7 support, security, content updates and promotion for steady growth.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: Pricing is individual and depends on design and technical complexity, the number of pages and modules (forms, live chat, calculators, galleries), CMS setup and whether you need ongoing support. We give an exact estimate after a consultation.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: On average we deliver a finished product in about a month, but it can be longer or shorter depending on the project’s complexity. We confirm exact timelines after a consultation.

items.q: Do you support the website after launch?
items.a: Yes. We keep the site running 24/7, protect it against viruses and hacking, keep every feature working, update information and online store catalogues, and publish photo, audio and video content.

items.q: Why outsource support instead of hiring in-house?
items.a: You save money and time, get round-the-clock service and a team that knows every detail of the project — because we built it. Without support, ads can burn budget on an unavailable site and malware or outages can wipe out SEO results.

We are a full-cycle agency: we care not only about code and features but also UI/UX, branding and marketing. The result meets the brief, solutions are tailored, prices are fair, and we stay with you after launch.

cta.lead: Let’s unlock your business’s full potential — together.
